tasks.name: Develop Code Submission UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to submit their code solutions.

tasks.name: Implement Code Evaluation System
tasks.description: Develop the backend system to compile, run, and evaluate submitted code.

tasks.name: Implement User Profile Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage user data, stats, and achievements.

tasks.name: Create Leaderboard UI
tasks.description: Design the frontend interface for displaying the leaderboard.

tasks.name: Implement Leaderboard Backend

tasks.name: Implement Hints and Tutorials Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage and serve hints and tutorials for problems.

tasks.name: Test Problem Library Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the problem library works as expected.

tasks.name: Test Code Submission and Evaluation
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure code submission and evaluation works correctly.

tasks.name: Test User Profiles
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure user profiles display correct data and function properly.

tasks.name: Test Leaderboard
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the leaderboard updates and displays rankings correctly.

tasks.name: Test Hints and Tutorials
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure hints and tutorials are displayed and managed correctly.

tasks.name: Deploy ACM Problem-Solving Platform
tasks.description: Deploy the platform to a production environment.

T1.implementation_approach: Design a clean and intuitive UI for browsing, searching, and filtering problems using a frontend framework like React.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design and accessibility compliance.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem data retrieval, creation, and updates using a backend framework like Node.js or Django.
T2.notes: Focus on scalability and secure data handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database (e.g., PostgreSQL) to store problem metadata, tags, and content.
T3.notes: Optimize schema for efficient querying and future scalability.

T4.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface for code submission with syntax highlighting and file upload support.
T4.notes: Integrate with the backend for real-time feedback on submission status.

T5.implementation_approach: Build a system to securely execute and evaluate submitted code in isolated environments like Docker containers.
T5.notes: Ensure proper handling of timeouts, memory limits, and security risks.

T6.implementation_approach: Create a visually appealing UI for user profiles displaying stats, achievements, and activity history.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage user data, achievements, and activity logs.
T7.notes: Ensure secure authentication and data privacy.

T8.implementation_approach: Design a leaderboard UI to display top users with sorting and filtering options.
T8.notes: Include real-time updates for dynamic rankings.

T9.implementation_approach: Implement backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings based on user performance.
T9.notes: Optimize for real-time updates and scalability.

T10.implementation_approach: Design an interactive UI for displaying hints and tutorials alongside problems.
T10.notes: Ensure hints are context-sensitive and non-intrusive.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage and serve hints and tutorials linked to specific problems.
T11.notes: Allow for easy content updates by admins.

T12.implementation_approach: Perform end-to-end testing of the problem library's UI and backend functionality.
T12.notes: Use automated testing tools like Selenium for efficiency.

T13.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation system for correctness, security, and performance.
T13.notes: Simulate various edge cases and malicious inputs.

T14.implementation_approach: Verify the user profile system's functionality, including data accuracy and UI responsiveness.
T14.notes: Test with different user roles and data loads.

T15.implementation_approach: Test the leaderboard for accurate ranking calculations and real-time updates.
T15.notes: Ensure proper handling of ties and edge cases.

T16.implementation_approach: Validate the hints and tutorials system for correct content delivery and UI integration.
T16.notes: Test for usability and relevance of hints.

T17.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform to a cloud service like AWS or Azure with CI/CD pipelines for seamless updates.
T17.notes: Ensure proper monitoring and logging for post-deployment support.
